About this vendor

Gabriella
WEDDING PLANNER
Typically responds within 24h
AWARD WINNER (7X)
Thanks to recommendations from couples on The Knot
You deserve to be the star of your wedding day—free to laugh, dance, and soak in every moment ✨ Our role is to guide you through a seamless, stress-free experience, ensuring your story shines the way you’ve always imagined. Why Couples Trust Us Worry-Free Planning 🙌 From our user-friendly client portal to transparent packages, we make sure nothing stands in the way of you enjoying your day. Authentic Style 📸 We capture natural, emotional photography and videography that reflect who you are—so you relive real memories, not staged poses. Proven Reputation ⭐ With thousands of couples served, hundreds of 5-star reviews, and numerous awards won over the years, we’re honored to be your trusted guide. How It Works 1. Check Availability – Reach out to confirm your date and share your vision. You set the tone; we make it happen. 2. Choose Your Package – We’ll recommend options tailored to your style, coverage needs, and budget, so you stay in control. 3. Celebrate Fully – On your wedding day, you’re the hero of the story. We’ll be right behind the scenes capturing each heartfelt moment. Ready to Feel Confident in Your Photo & Video Vendor Choice? Visit www.originalweddings.com to secure your date, explore our packages, and download our free wedding day timeline. With Original Weddings, you’ll have a caring guide and stunning results—leaving you free to cherish every second of your celebration. 🌐 www.originalweddings.com

We loved our experience with Sound Originals! The photo and video package was priced reasonably and the team was fantastic. We actually got our photos in two weeks which was well before the estimated delivery date! Rebekah was our lead photographer and she was a pleasure to work with, so nice! We had a very stormy day during our wedding and she arrived on time and early. The quality of the photos were wonderful and she captured authentic moments, as well as flattering angles, and utilized lighting to add an artistic flare to photos. We really wanted our dip captured at the end of the aisle and she literally sprinted to ensure we got it, and it was an EPIC photo. Our favorite one. We have not received our video yet as it is too early so we can’t comment on that but everyone from Sound Originals was very kind and organized on our wedding day and were inconspicuous during ceremony and reception. Thank you Rebekah and Sound Originals!

I am very, very happy with our decision in choosing Original Wedding photo and video for my wedding. We got married at Calamigos ranch in Malibu. They were there from 2 PM to 10 PM. We got to do all of my bridal shots, my close and detailed shots of my ring and my dress, bridesmaid shots, groomsmen shots, and so much more. My husband and I had a lot of traditions we wanted to be emphasized, and I can’t begin to describe how amazing the photos turned out. We had a military sword arch, private vows, and Jewish traditions, and they were all captured beautifully. I asked the photographer if they could take subtle photos of us reading our vows together because we wanted to do it in private, but I wanted to still capture the moment, and they were able to give us our privacy while we read our vows. At the end of the readings, we thought they had left because they were so quiet! However, they were hiding behind a plant and the photos turned out so raw, emotional, and beautiful. It was exactly our vision. Not only was their whole team very easy to talk to, but also they were very nice and very attentive. We could tell that the team was on the same page and had spent time looking through our wedding Pinterest board beforehand. Amazing team work! Quality: We just got our photo gallery, and we are completely blown away by how beautifully the love and pure joy were captured. It’s been about 3 weeks since our wedding, which is SUCH a fast turnaround time especially for 11 HOURS of footage. We could not have asked for a better photography & videography experience. Even though there were 2 photographers, the style and editing were standardized so that all photos blended seamlessly. We didn’t have to worry about any potential differences in photography styles! Value: Pricing was reasonable for market standard and by far the best we’d seen during research, especially considering the high quality that we received and the extended amount of time that we were looking to cover. To summarize, we would highly recommend Original Weddings (which used to be Sound Originals) to couples who are looking for high quality photos at a reasonable cost and a responsive planning team. They’re a big organization with many locations across the U.S. which makes them more accessible no matter where you’re planning to have your wedding.

The photographers and videographers were great, but the business practice is shady. I paid 4000 for a package of 2 photographers and 1 videographer, and the work was great. later on when I received the final photos and videos, I noticed the first dance was missing. This was important to me because my close friend had performed a beautiful song for me. I was depending on that footage to keep the memory. When I asked them for the raw footage of the first dance (mind you I did not ask them to edit or do any additional work, I literally just wanted the raw footage of that dance that already exists), they told me that they would send it to me for 1000 dollars. I wouldn’t have minded paying for it, but 1000 dollars is insane- I asked why they needed 1000 dollars to send me a clip that already exists, the work had already been done, and they said “we need to pay our employees health insurance and uploading a file can take longer than you expect”. It was the shadiest answer I have ever received and I started to get scammer vibes after this. Again, the photographers and videographers were great- it was the shady business practices that made this a bad decision for me.
